title: The Eye of the Storm

It intends to isolate and capture Rassimov, the leader of the Blood Spirals.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The information regarding Rassimov's location was given by Zhalia Moon, who undercover at the Blood Spiral base, overheard him pitch a secret mission to Harrison Fears regarding the Necklace of Tutankhamun.

After Ariel erased the team's footsteps, the plan was set in motion when Rassimov was about to enter the Tomb of Tutankhamun. A coordinated sequence of attacks by the Huntik team, aided by Ariel's tornado to hinder Rassimov's vision, countered his magic while Harrison was fighting Den Fears. Rassimov then tried to use his most powerful spell, Darkvoid, to get himself out of the situation. This was already expected by the Huntik team, as Dante invoked Maelstrom to absorb his power. Now completely cornered, he was restrained and taken by two Huntik Foundation members in a vehicle, his Titans being taken by Dante. Harrison then ran away and used Powermark on a Bazela's Insect, recovering quickly from the encounter.

However, as the team explored the tomb, Harrison attacked the vehicles taking Rassimov. Dante and company then encountered them on the way back. A fight ensues where the Huntik team have the upper hand, but things take a turn for the worse when Rassimov invokes Legion, whose amulet was hidden inside his body. The team struggles heavily against the nigh-invincible Legendary Titan of War, and it manages to absorve Solwing and Lindorm, with Rassimov taking the Necklace of Tutankhamun. Dante is then forced to retreat and take everyone injured to a Huntik Foundation hospital, and the mission is ultimately unsuccessful. [Rassimov's Secret]

The mission was so exhausting for the team that even in the following days, Dante could not invoke Caliban and was overall too tired to fight or use any magic. [Back Home]
